newsitem.title: USA: QuadraMed acquires stake in EDI USA.
newsitem.headline: QuadraMed acquires stake in EDI USA.

text.p: QuadraMed Corp on Thursday said it paid $2.5 million for a 10.2 percent equity stake in EDI USA, Inc, a group formed to build and operate a national electronic information system for healthcare transactions.
Connecticut-based EDI USA is owned by 13 independent Blue Cross and Blue Shield Plans. It currently has contracts with 52 Blue Cross and Blue Shield Plans and more than 300 commercial customers.
James Durham, QuadraMed chief executive officer, will serve as a director of EDI USA.
In a statement, QuadraMed said it will gain increased access to Blue Cross and Blue Shield Plans, as well as to other payers and providers.
QuadraMed offers EDI USA needed technology and solutions with a customer-focused approach.
